title: Qualify historical audit reports adversarially and in CI
objective: Execute the ENG-07.5 report validator self-check, add focused synthetic adversarial qualification, and wire both checks into the existing bootstrap without executing real historical audits or remediation.
non_goals: populate or persist real historical findings reports or remediation queues
change report or findings semantics except to fix a demonstrated validator defect
modify immutable historical evidence business code contracts or reports

forbidden_semantics: real historical findings report or remediation queue population

required_invariants: report validator self-check executes in bootstrap before WU completion
adversarial tests cover source bindings counts status queue completeness priority ordering owner triage action identity and Lot45 exclusion
qualification uses synthetic findings registries reports mappings manifests and plans only
CI adds exactly the report self-check and report adversarial test steps without a new workflow
no dependency installation network access or paid service is introduced
no real historical report or remediation queue is created by qualification
any core correction remains within the WU01 schema policy validator family and preserves declared semantics
acceptance_criteria: validator --self-check passes for CLEAN BLOCKED ACTION_REQUIRED and RESOLVED
adversarial suite passes with at least 16 focused probes
forged registry manifest mapping plan batch lot or audit-result bindings fail closed
forged report status queue priority triage action owner or report identity fails closed
queue omission duplication reordering extra entries or non-contiguous queue ids fail closed
closed findings never enter remediation queue and every OPEN finding does
Lot45 or later report fails closed through validated source binding
bootstrap executes both report qualification steps successfully
Security Secrets remains green on the same exact head

done_when: report validator self-check and adversarial suite pass on exact head in bootstrap
Security Secrets passes on the same exact head
no real historical audit report remediation queue or remediation occurred
